entries.description: One newly authored complete empty straddle-carrier vehicle exterior. entries.description: One entirely newly authored stylised dry bottle-trunk tree. Compared with the old narrow tapered umbrella trunk and its connected broad green crown, and the low riverbank fork with a long leaning leader and two green crown masses, this is a complete high-shouldered swollen-trunk dry-tree form. One model zero scenes. Coarse stylised environmental tree only, not exact baobab taxonomy, living growth, wood mechanics, ecology or safety. Rig animation interaction not made.
